Investing basics

Before investing

Build an emergency fund and pay down high-interest debt first. Then consider Pag-IBIG MP2, SSS, UITFs, or index funds. Start with what you understand and diversify over time.

Risk and return

Conservative options (time deposits, bonds) offer lower return and lower risk. Equity (stocks, equity UITFs) can grow more over the long term but with more volatility. Match your choices to your goal horizon and risk tolerance.
